WITH race_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.circuitId,
    c.country,
    COUNT(*) as race_count
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE r.date >= '1978-03-04' AND r.date <= '2003-03-09'
  GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    AVG(CAST(race_count AS FLOAT)) as avg_race_count
  FROM race_counts
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT 
  rc.circuitId,
  rc.country,
  rc.race_count,
  CASE 
    WHEN ca.avg_race_count > 0
    THEN CAST(rc.race_count AS FLOAT) / ca.avg_race_count
    ELSE NULL
  END as ratio
FROM race_counts rc
JOIN country_averages ca ON rc.country = ca.country
ORDER BY 
  ratio IS NULL,
  ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
